faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bathinda Perfusionist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Perfusionist post at AIIMS Bathinda is 20 October 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Perfusionist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc Degree from a recognized university and a Certificate in Perfusion Technology from a recognized institution with at least one year of experience in Clinical Perfusion.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC candidates.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the AIIMS Bathinda Perfusionist recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the official notification, there is no application fee for General/OBC and PwBD categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Perfusionist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be appointed at Level 6 of the pay matrix, plus Dearness Allowance (DA).

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Perfusionist post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Perfusionist position announced by AIIMS Bathinda.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Verification, an Interview, and potentially a Written Exam if the number of applicants is high.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a contractual position at AIIMS Bathinda.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page by clicking the provided link.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Punjab apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification mentions applications are invited from eligible candidates in Punjab. However, it is advisable to check the detailed eligibility criteria in the official notification for any specific residency requirements.
